definitions.explanation: Describes something that is smaller than the standard or regular size. Used as a noun modifier to indicate a compact or miniature version of something.

examples.japanese: {小型|こがた}の{犬|いぬ}が{好|す}きだ。
{小型|こがた}カメラで{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo with a compact camera.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{小型|こがた}のノートパソコンが{人気|にんき}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Recently, compact laptops have been gaining popularity.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with の or directly before another noun: {小型|こがた}の～ or {小型|こがた}～. The opposite is {大型|おおがた} (large-sized). Can also be read こがた when used independently, but always こがた when modifying a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小型|こがた}{車|しゃ}: compact car
- {小型|こがた}{犬|けん}: small dog breed
- {小型|こがた}カメラ: compact camera
- {超|ちょう}{小型|こがた}: ultra-compact
